receipt.message: The origin filter prevent the call to be dispatched.

error.message: The origin filter prevent the call to be dispatched.
error.name: CallFiltered
error.remediation: sign with the key or origin that owns the target object, then retry
error.description: The runtime's origin call filter (e.g. `BaseCallFilter` or a restricted origin) rejected this call before dispatch. Check whether the specific call is permitted for the origin you used, including any proxy or safe-mode filtering in effect.

receipt.message: Sender is not a proxy of the account to be proxied.

error.message: Sender is not a proxy of the account to be proxied.
error.name: NotProxy
error.remediation: sign with the key or origin that owns the target object, then retry
error.description: The sender is not registered as a proxy for the account it tried to act for. Check the `Proxies` entry of the `real` account and confirm the sender appears there with a proxy type and delay compatible with the call.
